english_intents.settings_safety_detail: Quarantine is reversible movement within the source root. Every move requires preparation and confirmation. The journal supports recovery after restarting. Do not manually move files or delete recovery data.
english_intents.preview_cache_detail: The preview LRU cache holds up to 64 MiB of decoded images in memory while running. This is neither disk space nor measured current usage. An individual preview may briefly use extra memory; history thumbnails are not cached. Recovery data is separate and persistent.
